services.name: UTV Rentals
services.desc: Many Riverfront guests reserve a UTV for the convenience of getting around during their stay. Riverfront stretches nearly a mile along the Niangua River, and many guests rent a UTV to move easily between campsites, river access, the pool, and other amenities. UTVs make hauling coolers, chairs, and gear simple - so you can spend more time enjoying your stay and less time walking back and forth. services.desc: If river conditions are unsafe, we issue a rain check valid for one year. Your float date is secured, and we monitor river conditions daily for safety. Camping and lodging stays continue as scheduled if sites remain usable even when floating is paused. To speed up check-in, all adults complete a short digital waiver before arrival.
